goal: Improve source-supported METHOD/TASK/DATASET and USED_FOR/EVALUATED_ON extraction, not graph size.
selection: Eligible whole TRAIN abstracts in immutable source order; select four previously known evaluation-positive papers, then four explicit-negative papers, then four dataset-containing papers with unresolved candidates and no known evaluation positive; no repeated paper. Uses historical TRAIN labels for purposive review selection, not predictions or dev/test errors.

tasks.title: Only original title supplies entities and relation evidence; never backfill a title label from an abstract.
tasks.abstract: Original whole abstract only, no title/URL concatenation; local mention endpoints with explicit predicate and attribution. Components do not inherit our model's evaluation.

entityRules.METHOD: Named models, algorithms, architectures and clearly designated method families; exclude hardware, receiver/object of an operation, generic pronouns and context-only domain words.
entityRules.TASK: Explicit research task or objective; a data modality/object alone is not a task. No abstract-level task propagated to every method mention.
entityRules.DATASET: Explicitly named dataset or benchmark; conferences, metrics and training hardware are not datasets. Dataset mention does not imply evaluation.
entityRules.boundaries: Exact Unicode code-point spans, shortest complete technical name; preserve versions and standalone alias occurrences; non-overlapping, source ordered. Shared-head coordination ambiguity stays quarantined.

relationRules.USED_FOR: Explicit evidence attributes performing the task to the head method, not merely co-occurrence or being the object assessed/compressed.
relationRules.EVALUATED_ON: Explicit evaluation on the named dataset attributed to the head method; training use, reporting a benchmark or being a component alone is insufficient.
relationRules.NO_RELATION: Require explicit_argument_role_contrast or explicit_dataset_use_contrast and a source-local explanation; poor performance, absence or co-occurrence alone are not negatives.
relationRules.UNRESOLVED: Preserve uncertainty and mask in training; never relabel as NO_RELATION.
relationRules.NOT_EXPRESSED: Diagnostic absence of a local predicate, not a factual negative or automatic training label.

review: AI-assisted initial decisions plus disclosed same-session source review, not independent human gold; initial pilot inherits old labels for review, not newly certified training labels.
evaluation: Keep prior exposed dev/test results historical. Plan a new paper-group-disjoint evaluation before training, with random representative set separate from targeted rare-class challenge. Full-pipeline predictions and zero-positive documents stay in denominator; report P/R/F1, per-class source-paper support, coverage and FP/FN.
phaseExit: Source integrity and split checks pass; twelve review dossiers prepared; inherit counts without certifying semantics. Training requires a separately locked reviewed snapshot and evaluation/selection contract.
